Thursday Parvilla Shop Ride

Edgewater, MD · Road

Thursday Parvilla Shop Ride is a road group ride in Edgewater, MD. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Parvilla Cycles.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: recovery pace; A/B split after 5 miles. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @abrtcycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Parvilla Shop Ride group ride

A 23-mile evening shop ride south of Annapolis, billed as recovery and enjoyment rather than training. The group splits into A and B after the first five miles. Runs spring through mid-October.
